sources.title: Reddit tauri community transparent overlay clickthrough discussion

findings.claim: Tauri v2 transparent click-through windows require set_ignore_cursor_events(true) to allow clicks to pass through to underlying applications.
evidence: Tested in codebase, verified to make window background click-through.

findings.claim: Edge WebView2 initial startup flash is avoided by setting visible(false) on window creation and calling show() only after content loads or recording is armed.
evidence: Checked visually, startup white flashes are eliminated when delayed shown.
sources: Reddit tauri community transparent overlay clickthrough discussion

recommendation: Use Tauri's set_ignore_cursor_events for transparency interaction and trigger show() programmatically on the Rust side after a delay/capture arming to bypass the Edge white-flash issue.
